counting_rule: Count every real tactical CLI process and fixed full-stage simulation at STARTED, including failures, exceptions, and timeouts; no retry, resume, replacement candidate, or historical balance transfer.

hard_roster_limit.counting_rule: Union of selected_low_star_operator_ids and all action-referenced operator IDs; retreat and redeploy count each ID once.

non_stackable: M60 remains CLI 1/1 and simulation 0/1. M59 remains simulation 1/1. Their balances are not transferred.
objective_rule: One GPT-authored plan must compare at least three structures, emit one complete at-most-8-ID plan, pass the original static compiler, then validate with at most one fixed full-stage simulation. Complete WIN freezes immediately.
